goal: Detect obvious and niche AI/vibe-coded website design patterns.
high_risk_patterns: gradient hero with badge and generic CTA
three-card feature grids with Lucide icons
shadcn defaults without a product design system

strictness.1: Balanced: catches obvious patterns with fewer false positives.
strictness.2: Strict: default, catches common and niche AI design tells.
strictness.3: Brutal: amplifies niche patterns and is best before a major redesign.
